summary: Pierce County, WA L-4 cab on Noble Knob, USFS-administered; built 1932-34 per sources, last used 1954, gone by 1961; 2026 footing caption; hike from gravel roads.

facts.status_note: Cab removed or destroyed between 1954 and 1961 per conflicting sources; no source describes a standing structure today

staffing.status: last used 1954; no named staff in these sources

access.note: Hike from gravel road approaches per WillhiteWeb (2 to 10 miles depending on route); the guide mentions no gate or permit

visit.trail_note: Hike of 2 to 10 miles depending on route; approach to Corral Pass via road 7174 from Highway 410, or logging roads from the Greenwater side

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest)

events.note: Register and Fire Lookout site give 1934 for the L-4 cab; WillhiteWeb says likely 1932 or 1933 (see resolved_conflicts)
WillhiteWeb: storage shed ordered in 1933; improvements ordered July 6, 1933
Panoramic photographs taken from the cab roof, August 15, 1934; Forest Lookouts credits George Clisby
WillhiteWeb: lookout last used in 1954; no staff named
Fire Lookout site: destroyed 1954 (disagrees with Register's removed)
WillhiteWeb: surveyors found the lookout abandoned in 1955
Registered June 18, 2012 as US 1289, WA 189; nominated by Ray Kresek
WillhiteWeb photo captions: 'Footing in 2026.' and 'Anchor in 2026.'

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Fire Lookout site say 1934; WillhiteWeb says the cab was likely built in 1932 or 1933, with a storage shed ordered in 1933. Not settled. The story reports both.
Register says removed in 1954; Fire Lookout site says destroyed in 1954; WillhiteWeb says last used 1954, found abandoned 1955, destroyed 1961. Not settled.

notes_for_editor: Build year and fate disagree across all three sources that give dates; the story says so and does not pick one. Brief's kind 'ground' is not confirmed by these sources, which do not say whether the cab stood on a tower or the ground. Access rated public from WillhiteWeb's hike description, which mentions no gate or permit; no agency closure notice was read. Staffing: WillhiteWeb gives only 'last used 1954' and names no staff. One WebSearch was run; its snippets (including a WTA page and a Corral Butte page) were not cited. Page reads used: 6.
